name: ExtenderX – Block Animation, Dark Mode & Content Protection
author: WPXERO

sections.description:
ExtenderX is the complete WordPress enhancement plugin that combines Gutenberg block animations, dark mode functionality, and content protection features in one powerful solution. Perfect for creating interactive websites while protecting your content from unauthorized copying and theft.

🎯 Key Features of ExtenderX

🌙 Dark Mode for WordPress
Enable dark mode on your WordPress website with a single click. Provide visitors with a comfortable viewing experience in low-light environments. Perfect for modern websites, blogs, and online stores looking to offer dark theme support.

🔒 Content Protection & Website Security
Protect your valuable content with comprehensive security features:

✅ Disable Right Click
Prevent unauthorized copying by disabling right click on your WordPress site. Stop visitors from accessing the context menu to copy images, text, or view page source.

✅ Disable Copy Paste
Prevent copy paste on your website to protect your written content from text theft. Essential for protecting original articles, blog posts, and copyrighted material.

✅ Disable Inspect Element
Disable browser inspect element and developer tools to deter users from accessing your website’s source code. Protect your design and code from being easily copied.

✅ Disable Image Drag
Prevent image downloading by disabling drag-and-drop functionality. Stop visitors from saving your images by simply dragging them to their desktop.

✨ Gutenberg Block Animation Effects

✅ Entrance Animations
Make blocks animate on scroll with smooth entrance effects. Great for creating engaging, scroll-triggered content that captures attention.

✅ Floating Animations
Add subtle floating block effects to make your content feel alive. Perfect for interactive WordPress designs.
Note: Floating animations do not work simultaneously with Entrance or Tilt animations.

✅ Tilt Effect
Apply a 3D tilt effect to blocks for depth and interactivity. Blocks respond to cursor movement, enhancing user engagement.

✅ Responsive Visibility Control
Show or hide blocks on desktop, tablet, or mobile. Essential for responsive web design and adaptive layouts.

✅ Parallax Scrolling
Add immersive parallax scrolling effects for modern, layered web designs.

✅ Tooltips
Add tooltips to Gutenberg blocks to display extra information without cluttering your design.

✅ Wrapper Links
Turn any block into a clickable block link for better navigation and user flow.

⚙️ Advanced Features

✅ Hide Admin Bar on Frontend
Remove the WordPress admin bar from the frontend for a cleaner, more professional visitor experience. Perfect for membership sites and client websites.

✅ Centralized Dashboard
Manage all ExtenderX features from one comprehensive dashboard. Easy access to animations, content protection, dark mode settings, and more.

🏆 Why Choose ExtenderX?

  • All-in-One Solution – animations, dark mode, and content protection in one plugin.
  • Easy to Use – beginner-friendly, no coding required.
  • Universal Compatibility – works with all Gutenberg & third-party block plugins.
  • Optimized for Speed – lightweight and performance-optimized, no bloat.
  • Content Security – protect your images, text, and code from theft.
  • Modern Features – dark mode support for better user experience.
  • Regular Updates – new features added frequently.
  • Perfect for Everyone – bloggers, photographers, designers, developers, and agencies.

License & Disclaimer

This plugin is licensed under GPL v2 or later. No warranties are provided. You are free to modify and distribute it under the same license.
sections.installation:
1. Download & Install : Upload the extenderx folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress Plugin Repository.

  2. Activate the Plugin : Navigate to the Plugins section of your WordPress dashboard and activate ExtenderX.

  3. Start Creating : Open the Gutenberg editor, choose any block, and start using ExtenderX features from the block settings sidebar.
sections.faq:
How do I enable dark mode on my WordPress website?

Simply activate ExtenderX and navigate to the plugin dashboard. Enable the Dark Mode feature with one click. Your website will automatically support dark theme viewing for visitors.

Can I disable right click on my WordPress site?

Yes! ExtenderX includes a disable right click feature that prevents visitors from accessing the context menu. This helps protect your content from unauthorized copying.

How do I prevent people from copying text from my website?

Use the Disable Copy Paste feature in ExtenderX. This prevents visitors from selecting and copying text content, protecting your original articles and written content from theft.

Can I disable inspect element and developer tools?

Yes. ExtenderX lets you disable inspect element and browser developer tools, making it harder for users to access your website’s source code and design elements.

How do I protect images from being downloaded?

Enable the Disable Image Drag feature to prevent visitors from downloading images via drag-and-drop. Combined with the disable right click feature, this provides comprehensive image protection.

Can I hide the WordPress admin bar from visitors?

Yes! The Hide Admin Bar on Frontend feature removes the admin bar for a cleaner, more professional look when logged-in users view the frontend.

Is ExtenderX a Gutenberg animation plugin?

Yes. ExtenderX is a complete WordPress enhancement plugin that includes a powerful Gutenberg animation system with entrance, tilt, floating, parallax, and motion effects.

Does ExtenderX work with third-party block libraries?

Absolutely. ExtenderX is compatible with popular plugins like Kadence Blocks, Stackable, Spectra, Ghostkit, Gutenverse, Essential Blocks, CoBlocks, and more.

Will ExtenderX slow down my website?

No. ExtenderX is optimized for performance. All features including animations and content protection are lightweight and designed to keep your site fast and responsive.

Can I control block visibility by device?

Yes. ExtenderX includes responsive visibility controls that let you show or hide blocks on desktop, tablet, or mobile.

Do I need coding knowledge to use ExtenderX?

Not at all! ExtenderX is beginner-friendly. You can enable dark mode, activate content protection, and add animations with just a few clicks from the centralized dashboard.

Is ExtenderX compatible with all Gutenberg blocks?

Yes, ExtenderX is fully compatible with all core Gutenberg blocks and popular third-party block plugins like Kadence Blocks, Ultimate Blocks, Spectra, Ghostkit, Essential Blocks, Gutenverse, Gutenkit, Stackable, Otter Blocks, Greenshift, CoBlocks, and others. Whether you’re using built-in blocks or custom ones from other plugins, ExtenderX works seamlessly.

Can I use dark mode and content protection together?

Yes! All ExtenderX features work together seamlessly. You can enable dark mode, protect your content, and add block animations simultaneously.

Is ExtenderX good for photographers and content creators?

Absolutely! The content protection features (disable right click, disable image drag, disable copy paste) are perfect for photographers, artists, writers, and anyone who wants to protect their original work from unauthorized copying.
